title: Baboon on a Limestone Base
culture: Egypt, Late period (715–332 BCE), Dynasty 30–Greco-Roman period (332 BCE–395 CE), Ptolemaic dynasty (305–30 BCE)
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text: "Words spoken by Harpocrates, given life and health, lord of heaven, (on behalf of) Padiuser, the son of Usernakht and [mother's name uncertain]."
passages.remark: On base, doesn't belong with the statue.

note: Translation concerns the separate base, which the museum says does not belong with the statuette.
